basic_info.description: Bright and spacious corner condo in coveted Cole Valley/Parnassus Heights spanning approx 1280sqft. In a well maintained 2-unit building, enjoy nature's beauty combined with city convenience. Tastefully updated with classic San Francisco details including renovated bathrooms plus a gourmet kitchen. An entry foyer welcomes guests elegantly to the large living and dining areas, which boast corner bay windows and glimpses of Golden Gate Park. Includes a one-car garage and generous storage. Just steps to UCSF Biosciences Hub, Muni transportation, Cole Valley's shops and restaurants, Golden Gate Park, and the Inner Sunset's Irving Corridor!
